display.purpose: Page titles and stat-tile values; the only large type. Familjen Grotesk 700, tight tracking.

headline.purpose: Section headers, top-bar month label, sidebar brand.

body.purpose: All running text, form values, table cells. Public Sans.

label.purpose: Uppercase table column headers and eyebrow labels.

mono.purpose: Every amount, date, and count. DM Mono, tabular-nums.

shadows.name: rest
shadows.purpose: Barely-there settle under cards at rest and the segmented control's active thumb.

shadows.name: floating
shadows.purpose: Dialogs, toasts, and the mobile sidebar drawer — the only truly overlaid surfaces.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Default easing for every transition and entrance.

motion.name: fast
motion.purpose: Micro-transitions: hover fills, caret rotation, switch thumb.

motion.name: base
motion.purpose: Dialog/toast entrances, drawer slide, progress fills.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The default action; ink fill, used for the one primary action per view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: #14161a; color: #fff; border: 1px solid #14161a; font-family: 'Public Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; padding: 7px 13px; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.9,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #2a2e36; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #14161a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action; surface fill with a hairline-strong border.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: #fff; color: #14161a; border: 1px solid #d5d9df; font-family: 'Public Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; padding: 7px 13px; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.9,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #f5f6f8; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #14161a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive action; the one place a money colour enters the chrome.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: #bc2f3e; color: #fff; border: 1px solid #bc2f3e; font-family: 'Public Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; padding: 7px 13px; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.9,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: #a52836; } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #14161a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard field; quiet at rest, ink ring on focus, red border on error.
components.css: .ds-input { font-family: 'Public Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 13.5px; padding: 7px 10px; border: 1px solid #d5d9df; border-radius: 6px; background: #fff; color: #14161a; width: 220px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #99a0aa; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #14161a; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-input.error { border-color: #bc2f3e; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Type/mode switcher; a wash track with a pressed-forward active thumb.
components.css: .ds-segmented { display: inline-flex; background: #f5f6f8; border: 1px solid #e6e8ec; border-radius: 6px; padding: 2px; gap: 2px; } .ds-segmented button { border: 0; background: transparent; font-family: 'Public Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 12.5px; color: #666d78; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-segmented button[aria-selected="true"] { background: #fff; color: #14161a; font-weight: 600; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(20,22,26,0.05); }

components.name: Active Nav Item
components.description: Sidebar item; the active state is a solid ink fill — where a branded app would tint.
components.html: MêsRelatórios
components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; gap: 2px; width: 200px; font-family: 'Public Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 7px 10px; border-radius: 6px; color: #666d78; font-size: 13.5px; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:hover { background: #f5f6f8; color: #14161a; } .ds-nav a[aria-current="page"] { background: #14161a; color: #fff; font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Draft Badge
components.description: Marks an unconfirmed voice entry; a dashed outline reads as provisional.
components.css: .ds-badge-draft { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font-family: 'Public Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.03em; padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 5px; background: transparent; border: 1px dashed #d5d9df; color: #666d78; }

components.name: Stat Tile
components.description: A dense card carrying one headline figure; the number borrows the display face.
components.css: .ds-stat { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e6e8ec; border-radius: 10px; padding: 11px 14px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(20,22,26,0.05); width: 180px; } .ds-stat .k { font-family: 'Public Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 11.5px; color: #666d78; } .ds-stat .v { font-family: 'Familjen Grotesk', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.3rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: -0.03em; margin-top: 1px; }

narrative.overview: This is a reading instrument for a household's money, not a brand experience. Its governing decision is that colour belongs to the data and never to the chrome. There is no brand accent — the frame is built entirely from ink (#14161a) and hairline greys, so the only saturated colour on any screen comes from what the data means: the four money colours and the sixteen category swatches. The result reads as precise and restrained: high density, monospaced tabular numbers, structure drawn with 1px lines and pale washes rather than boxes and shadows. The system commits to one appearance — light only — and treats desktop and phone as equals.
keyCharacteristics: No brand colour — chrome is ink and hairline grey; hue means data.
Four fixed money colours + sixteen category swatches, each a single value.
Monospaced tabular numbers everywhere a figure appears.
Near-flat: depth from lines and washes, shadows reserved for what truly lifts.
Light-only, tuned to a 4.5:1 contrast floor.
Familjen Grotesk / Public Sans / DM Mono — three roles, three families.

rules.name: The No-Brand Rule
rules.body: No colour is decorative and no colour is the brand. If a hue is on screen it is because the data underneath it has that meaning. The chrome is ink and grey, always.

rules.name: The Value Names Rule
rules.body: Colour groups; the number names. Sixteen hues cannot be told apart in a donut, least of all by a colour-blind reader, so a chart always labels the slice with its own amount. Never require the reader to match a swatch to a legend.

rules.name: The Money-Is-Fixed Rule
rules.body: The four money colours are semantic constants. They do not shift with any future theme decision, because a green that stops meaning 'in' breaks every table.

rules.name: The Tabular Number Rule
rules.body: Every figure is DM Mono with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums. Money that does not align down the column cannot be scanned, and scanning is the whole job.

rules.name: The Number-As-Display Rule
rules.body: The largest numbers on screen borrow Familjen Grotesk at 700 with tight tracking — a headline figure, not body text scaled up.

rules.name: The Hairline-First Rule
rules.body: Reach for a 1px line or a wash before a shadow. A shadow is a claim that the element is above the page; if it is not, it gets a line.

dos: Do keep all chrome ink-and-grey. Buttons, active nav, focus rings, headers, avatars, tooltips, toasts are ink (#14161a).
Do set every amount, date, and count in DM Mono with tabular-nums (.num).
Do build structure from 1px lines and washes first; use a shadow only for a card at rest or something that truly floats.
Do label chart slices with their own amount, so meaning never depends on matching a swatch to a legend.
Do keep the four money colours exactly as defined — they are semantic constants, not theme choices.
Do design the phone layout as an equal: drawer sidebar, and frozen-column horizontal scroll for matrices that can't reflow.
donts: Don't introduce a brand accent colour anywhere in the chrome. The absence is the identity.
Don't add dark mode or a second value for any token. The system is light-only by decision.
Don't set an amount in the body face, or let a number column go non-tabular.
Don't wrap surfaces in shadows to create hierarchy where a hairline or wash would do.
Don't repurpose a money colour for decoration, or let green/red mean 'good/bad' anywhere except the one confirmed against-the-average column.
Don't collapse the report matrices to cards on mobile — freeze the first column and scroll.
